run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p1, p2 : Person | some disj c1, c2 : Course | some disj j1 : Project | some disj g1, g2 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p1 + p2
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = j1
        Grade = g1 + g2
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p1->c2 + p2->c1
        Person <: projects = p1->j1
        Course <: projects = c2->j1
        Course <: grades = c1->p2->g1 + c2->p1->g2
        Grade <: next = g1->g2
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 2 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario3 {
    some disj p1, p2, s1 : Person | some disj c1 : Course | some disj j1 : Project | some disj g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2 + s1
        Course = c1
        Project = j1
        Grade = g1
        Person <: teaches = p1->c1
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s1->c1
        Person <: projects = p2->j1 + s1->j1
        Course <: projects = c1->j1
        Course <: grades = c1->p2->g1 + c1->s1->g1
        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0
